ruling.recommended_action: Refer to RydeHELP human safety review: preserve chat log, driver statement, GPS and trip record; obtain the rider's statement; assess Code-of-Conduct action against the rider and advise the driver of 995 / commercial-insurance / RydeHELP channels; no fare adjustment on this record.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute (SAFE-1): in-trip threat of physical violence by the rider toward the driver, corroborated by the chat log and the driver's filed statement. No automated ruling; refer to a human reviewer for Code-of-Conduct handling and any account action.
